question: Part B: does the H1 fore-aft resistance effect of joint_LFCoxa and joint_LHCoxa reproduce prospectively, with only those two channels enabled, in CNS seeds 1-3?
known_before_registration: D3 per-leg results for seed 1 with all 13 H1 channels (LF -0.173/+0.145, LH -0.191/+0.206; RF and RH failed). Seeds 2 and 3 have never been run in this context. The 100-step smoke is plumbing only and discarded.

policy_part_a.decision: approved by the user on 2026-11-02 ('Approve, build it' on PR #313)
policy_part_a.CONDITIONAL: separately counted, never merged into 20/42; requires C1 binding fixed by rule before outcomes, C2 preregistered closed-loop falsification with sign-reversal control, C3 prospective isolated confirmation across new seeds (this test), C4 integrity; enabled only through the labelled hypothesis session path; results using it carry COXA_CONDITIONAL_H1; revocable by any later preregistered failure
policy_part_a.UNTESTED: middle-leg coxa channels; joint_LFCoxa_yaw, joint_LHCoxa_roll, joint_LHCoxa_yaw; all other coxa coordinates
policy_part_a.NOT_SUPPORTED: a coordinate whose preregistered confirmation fails

sources.d3_module: malecns_backend.live.coxa_hypothesis_loop (definitions, create_hypothesis_session, Trial, mean_by_leg, first_command_change; its protocol() hash lock b8d524d5...)

candidates.hash_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(native(defs), sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) of the two channels from coxa_hypothesis_loop.definitions(<D2 arm>, D2 channels)

context: Step C A_ON for every arm (assisted posture, hair plates delivered, schedule, encoder, 20 v3 channels unchanged), 20000 physics steps, 4000 neural ticks; one fresh process per arm, each run once.

seeds.mechanism: input adapter attach: require brain.time_ms == 0, zero spike counts and brain.rng state equal to a fresh default_rng(1) (else run error -> PROTOCOL_NOT_BUILDABLE); then brain.rng = numpy.random.default_rng(seed). Kernel unchanged.

integrity.I1: all nine arms COMPLETE, 20001 samples, 4000 ticks
integrity.I2: within each seed, identical external schedule and per-tick uniforms_sha256 across C0/CAND/FLIP
integrity.I3: C0_1 equals saved Step C A_ON in fired, uniforms_sha256, hair_delivered (every tick) and qpos (every sample)
integrity.I4: 20 v3 channel inventories identical to C0_1 in every arm; C0 has no hypothesis channel and never changes candidate commands; CAND/FLIP channel set = v3 + the two candidates, definitions hash equals the preregistered one; non-v3, non-candidate commands equal C0_s; every candidate offset |c| <= 0.25 rad
integrity.I5: within each seed, CAND and FLIP equal C0_s in qpos and commanded joints before their first candidate command, and in fired before that time
integrity.I6: tick-1 uniforms_sha256 of C0_1, C0_2, C0_3 pairwise different; every arm records its cns_seed

measure: window-mean change vs C0_s of the leg's coxa forward component (hair_forward, Step B encoder geometry), as in D3

labels.seed_pass: C0_s hair rate of the leg > 0 (firing) AND CAND_s delta_f <= -0.02 AND FLIP_s delta_f >= +0.02; a non-firing leg is a failed seed
labels.PARTIAL: passes in 1-2 seeds -> remains hypothesis, no tier change

flags.BOUND_LIMITED: for any CAND or FLIP arm, the fraction of window samples with |offset| >= 0.24 rad exceeds 0.5
flags.ROLLOVER: any sample of any arm with body tilt > 90 deg

descriptive: delta_f in all legs; coxa MN rates per leg; hair rates and deliveries; channel offsets mean/max; first command and first physical divergence; tilt mean/peak; comparison with D3 seed-1 all-channel effects
predictions: Recorded in the design doc: both CONFIRMED; risks isolation, seed variation, LH near the cap (BOUND_LIMITED plausible).
interpretation_limits: Consistency with one published reflex (CxHP8 resistance) in one assisted context; not validation of the binding.
Offset-on-servo actuation: a shift is a servo setpoint shift, not muscle force.
CONDITIONAL is a project policy, not anatomical validation or admission; 20/42 is unchanged.
Seeds change only stochastic sensory event timing; connectome, engine and initial state are identical.
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed; no reruns, no rule changes.
